{{Quote|The tracking station at Pastil is fully operational. Captain Rex and I are proceeding to the outpost in the Rishi system.|Cody, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="GA">''[[The Clone Wars: Grievous Attacks!]]''</ref>}}
'''Pastil''' was an astronomical object<ref name="TOSVC32">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 32|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 32]]</ref> located in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated along the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]] near the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Tracking station duty means being the first line of defense against the Separatists. And the first line of defense requires vigilance, discipline.|Cody, to the rookie clone troopers stationed on Pastil|<ref name="MH" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Pastil was the location of a [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and operated by [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="MH" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref><ref name="Rookies Date">{{TCWdates|105}}</ref> [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] inspected the [[Listening post/Legends|tracking station]] on Pastil.<ref name="MH" /> During their inspection, they [[Skirmish on Pastil|uncovered]] a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]],<ref name="TOSVC32" /> a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] that was nicknamed "[[Rodent (droid)|Rodent]]" by the rookie clone troopers stationed on Pastil.<ref name="MH" />

Following their inspection, Marshal Commander Cody and Captain Rex reported to [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] that the tracking station was fully operational, and proceeded to the [[Rishi Station/Legends|outpost]] in the [[Rishi system/Legends|Rishi system]], where they [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|prevented]] a major [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] incursion.<ref name="Rookies" />
